patch_description:
Return to program 2's efficient single-block structure (which scored 0.59) but enhance it with parity-split RZ rotations on pre and post phases. This applies the recommendation by splitting rz_pre into rz_pre_even and rz_pre_odd, and rz_post into rz_post_even and rz_post_odd. This adds only 2 parameters (10 to 12) while preserving the shallow depth (15) and maintaining the even/odd symmetry already present in the RY layer pattern. The controlled gate pattern (CRX, CRY, CRZ) from program 2 proved effective. This should:
- Tighten the generalization gap through finer phase control
- Maintain parameter economy with only 12 distinct parameters
- Keep the fast convergence (90 steps)
- Improve robustness on hard samples by respecting the underlying even/odd symmetry
